```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(genio)
library(simtrait)
library(metalcor)
```

```{r}
# calculate evaluation metrics for SAMAFS
setwd("/home/tt207/pro00108518/t2d-samafs/study2/exome_chip/cryptic-relatedness/")
bim = read_plink("/home/tt207/pro00108518/t2d-samafs/study2/exome_chip/exome_chip_qc")$bim

align_to_subset <- function(df, subset_bim, id_col, p_col) {
  idx <- match(subset_bim$id, df[[id_col]])
  df_aligned <- df[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  df_aligned$p.value <- df_aligned[[p_col]]
  df_aligned
}

# Iterate over each rep
file_names = c("joint_loco", "joint_noloco", "meta_sex_loco", "meta_sex_noloco",
               "metacorr_loco", "metacorr_noloco")
combined_df = c()
for (rep_num in 1:10){
  joint_loco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_simtrait_loco.txt")
  joint_noloco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_simtrait.txt")
  meta_loco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/metal/output/simtrait_loco_", rep_num, ".1txt")
  meta_noloco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/metal/output/simtrait_noloco_", rep_num, ".1txt")
  bim_mask_id_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/bim_mask_id.txt")

  # Sex-stratified SAIGE outputs for meta_corr
  male_loco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_male_simtrait_loco.txt")
  female_loco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_female_simtrait_loco.txt")
  male_noloco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_simtrait_male.txt")
  female_noloco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_simtrait_female.txt")

  # Read in the data
  joint_loco <- read.table(joint_loco_file, header = TRUE)
  joint_noloco <- read.table(joint_noloco_file, header = TRUE)
  meta_loco <- read.table(meta_loco_file, header = TRUE) %>%
      select(id = MarkerName, p.value = P.value)
  meta_sex_loco = merge(meta_loco, bim, by = "id") %>% arrange(chr, pos)
  meta_noloco <- read.table(meta_noloco_file, header = TRUE) %>%
      select(id = MarkerName, p.value = P.value)
  meta_sex_noloco = merge(meta_noloco, bim, by = "id") %>% arrange(chr, pos)

  # Run meta_corr (LOCO)
  df_male_loco <- read.table(male_loco_file, header = TRUE)
  df_female_loco <- read.table(female_loco_file, header = TRUE)
  study_male_loco <- df_male_loco %>%
    dplyr::select(id = MarkerID, chr = CHR, pos = POS, beta = BETA, se = SE, n = N)
  study_female_loco <- df_female_loco %>%
    dplyr::select(id = MarkerID, chr = CHR, pos = POS, beta = BETA, se = SE, n = N)
  obj_loco <- metalcor(list(study_female_loco, study_male_loco), median = TRUE)
  metacorr_loco <- data.frame(id = obj_loco$assoc$id, p.value = obj_loco$assoc$p)
  metacorr_loco <- merge(metacorr_loco, bim, by = "id") %>% arrange(chr, pos)

  # Run meta_corr (no-LOCO)
  df_male_noloco <- read.table(male_noloco_file, header = TRUE)
  df_female_noloco <- read.table(female_noloco_file, header = TRUE)
  study_male_noloco <- df_male_noloco %>%
    dplyr::select(id = MarkerID, chr = CHR, pos = POS, beta = BETA, se = SE, n = N)
  study_female_noloco <- df_female_noloco %>%
    dplyr::select(id = MarkerID, chr = CHR, pos = POS, beta = BETA, se = SE, n = N)
  obj_noloco <- metalcor(list(study_female_noloco, study_male_noloco), median = TRUE)
  metacorr_noloco <- data.frame(id = obj_noloco$assoc$id, p.value = obj_noloco$assoc$p)
  metacorr_noloco <- merge(metacorr_noloco, bim, by = "id") %>% arrange(chr, pos)

  # causal snp id's
  bim_mask_id <- read.table(bim_mask_id_file, header = TRUE) %>% pull(x)
  subset_bim = bim %>% filter(!id %in% bim_mask_id)
  causal_id = read.table(paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/causal_id.txt"),
                         header = TRUE)
  causal_markers = bim[causal_id$x,] %>% pull(id)
  marker_indices = match(causal_markers, subset_bim$id)
  if (anyNA(marker_indices)) {
    bad <- causal_markers[is.na(marker_indices)]
    stop("Some causal markers are missing from subset_bim after masking. Example: ",
         paste(head(bad, 5), collapse = ", "),
         " (n_missing=", sum(is.na(marker_indices)), ")")
  }

  # filter out masked id's
  joint_loco_masked <- align_to_subset(joint_loco, subset_bim, "MarkerID", "p.value")
  joint_noloco_masked <- align_to_subset(joint_noloco, subset_bim, "MarkerID", "p.value")
  meta_sex_loco_masked <- align_to_subset(meta_sex_loco, subset_bim, "id", "p.value")
  meta_sex_noloco_masked <- align_to_subset(meta_sex_noloco, subset_bim, "id", "p.value")
  metacorr_loco_masked <- align_to_subset(metacorr_loco, subset_bim, "id", "p.value")
  metacorr_noloco_masked <- align_to_subset(metacorr_noloco, subset_bim, "id", "p.value")

  # inflation values, srmsd, aucpr
  srmsd_vals <- numeric()
  inflation_vals <- numeric()
  auc_vals <- numeric()

  for (file in file_names) {
    print(file)
    masked_df <- paste0(file, "_masked")
    file <- get(file)
    masked <- get(masked_df)

    srmsd <- pval_srmsd(masked$p.value, marker_indices)
    srmsd_vals <- c(srmsd_vals, srmsd)

    auc <- pval_aucpr(masked$p.value, marker_indices, curve = FALSE)
    auc_vals <- c(auc_vals, auc)

    inflation <- pval_infl(file$p.value)
    inflation_vals <- c(inflation_vals, inflation)
  }

  analysis <- c("joint-loco", "joint", "sex-meta-loco", "sex-meta",
                "sex-meta-corr-loco", "sex-meta-corr")
  df <- data.frame(analysis, srmsd_vals, inflation_vals, auc_vals)
  df$rep <- rep_num
  combined_df = rbind(combined_df, df)
}

write.table(combined_df,
            "/home/tt207/pro00108518/t2d-samafs/study2/exome_chip/cryptic-relatedness/sim_traits/samafs_eval_metric_mask_1000000_metacorr.txt",
            col.names = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

for (rep_num in 7){
  print(paste("rep", rep_num))
  joint_loco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_simtrait_loco_1000.txt")
  joint_noloco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_simtrait_1000.txt")
  meta_loco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/metal/output/simtrait_loco_", rep_num, "_1000.1txt")
  meta_noloco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/metal/output/simtrait_noloco_", rep_num, "_1000.1txt")
  bim_mask_id_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/bim_mask_id_1000000_1000.txt")

  # Sex-stratified SAIGE outputs for meta_corr
  male_loco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_male_simtrait_loco_1000.txt")
  female_loco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_female_simtrait_loco_1000.txt")
  male_noloco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_simtrait_male_1000.txt")
  female_noloco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_simtrait_female_1000.txt")

  # Read in the data
  joint_loco <- read.table(joint_loco_file, header = TRUE)
  joint_noloco <- read.table(joint_noloco_file, header = TRUE)
  meta_loco <- read.table(meta_loco_file, header = TRUE) %>%
      select(id = MarkerName, p.value = P.value)
  meta_sex_loco = merge(meta_loco, bim, by = "id") %>% arrange(chr, pos)
  meta_noloco <- read.table(meta_noloco_file, header = TRUE) %>%
      select(id = MarkerName, p.value = P.value)
  meta_sex_noloco = merge(meta_noloco, bim, by = "id") %>% arrange(chr, pos)

  # Run meta_corr (LOCO)
  df_male_loco <- read.table(male_loco_file, header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  df_female_loco <- read.table(female_loco_file, header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  study_male_loco <- df_male_loco %>%
    dplyr::select(id = MarkerID, chr = CHR, pos = POS, beta = BETA, se = SE, n = N)
  study_female_loco <- df_female_loco %>%
    dplyr::select(id = MarkerID, chr = CHR, pos = POS, beta = BETA, se = SE, n = N)
  obj_loco <- metalcor(list(study_female_loco, study_male_loco), median = TRUE)
  metacorr_loco <- data.frame(id = obj_loco$assoc$id, p.value = obj_loco$assoc$p)
  metacorr_loco <- merge(metacorr_loco, bim, by = "id") %>% arrange(chr, pos)

  # Run meta_corr (no-LOCO)
  df_male_noloco <- read.table(male_noloco_file, header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  df_female_noloco <- read.table(female_noloco_file, header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  study_male_noloco <- df_male_noloco %>%
    dplyr::select(id = MarkerID, chr = CHR, pos = POS, beta = BETA, se = SE, n = N)
  study_female_noloco <- df_female_noloco %>%
    dplyr::select(id = MarkerID, chr = CHR, pos = POS, beta = BETA, se = SE, n = N)
  obj_noloco <- metalcor(list(study_female_noloco, study_male_noloco), median = TRUE)
  metacorr_noloco <- data.frame(id = obj_noloco$assoc$id, p.value = obj_noloco$assoc$p)
  metacorr_noloco <- merge(metacorr_noloco, bim, by = "id") %>% arrange(chr, pos)

  # causal snp id's
  bim_mask_id <- read.table(bim_mask_id_file, header = TRUE) %>% pull(x)
  subset_bim = bim %>% filter(!id %in% bim_mask_id)
  causal_id = read.table(paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/causal_id_1000.txt"),
                         header = TRUE)
  causal_markers = bim[causal_id$x,] %>% pull(id)
  marker_indices = match(causal_markers, subset_bim$id)
  if (anyNA(marker_indices)) {
    bad <- causal_markers[is.na(marker_indices)]
    stop("Some causal markers are missing from subset_bim after masking. Example: ",
         paste(head(bad, 5), collapse = ", "),
         " (n_missing=", sum(is.na(marker_indices)), ")")
  }

  # filter out masked id's
  joint_loco_masked <- align_to_subset(joint_loco, subset_bim, "MarkerID", "p.value")
  joint_noloco_masked <- align_to_subset(joint_noloco, subset_bim, "MarkerID", "p.value")
  meta_sex_loco_masked <- align_to_subset(meta_sex_loco, subset_bim, "id", "p.value")
  meta_sex_noloco_masked <- align_to_subset(meta_sex_noloco, subset_bim, "id", "p.value")
  metacorr_loco_masked <- align_to_subset(metacorr_loco, subset_bim, "id", "p.value")
  metacorr_noloco_masked <- align_to_subset(metacorr_noloco, subset_bim, "id", "p.value")

  # inflation values, srmsd, aucpr
  srmsd_vals <- numeric()
  inflation_vals <- numeric()
  auc_vals <- numeric()

  for (file in file_names) {
    print(file)
    masked_df <- paste0(file, "_masked")
    file <- get(file)
    masked <- get(masked_df)

    srmsd <- pval_srmsd(masked$p.value, marker_indices)
    srmsd_vals <- c(srmsd_vals, srmsd)

    auc <- pval_aucpr(masked$p.value, marker_indices, curve = FALSE)
    auc_vals <- c(auc_vals, auc)

    inflation <- pval_infl(file$p.value)
    inflation_vals <- c(inflation_vals, inflation)
  }

  analysis <- c("joint-loco", "joint", "sex-meta-loco", "sex-meta",
                "sex-meta-corr-loco", "sex-meta-corr")
  df <- data.frame(analysis, srmsd_vals, inflation_vals, auc_vals)
  df$rep <- rep_num
  df$causal_snp <- 1000
  combined_df = rbind(combined_df, df)
}

```{r}
# load previously saved evaluation metrics
samafs = read.table("/home/tt207/pro00108518/t2d-samafs/study2/exome_chip/cryptic-relatedness/sim_traits/samafs_eval_metric_mask_1000000_metacorr.txt", header = TRUE)
hchs = read.table("/home/tt207/pro00108518/hchs-sol/Ia/cryptic-relatedness/sim_traits/hchs_eval_metric_mask_1000000_causal_1000_metacorr.txt", header = TRUE) %>% select(-causal_snp)

combined_df = gdata::combine(samafs, hchs)

long_df <- combined_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(srmsd_vals, inflation_vals, auc_vals),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    LOCO = grepl("loco", analysis),
    analysis = sub("-loco$", "", analysis)
  ) %>%
  mutate(LOCO = ifelse(LOCO == TRUE, "used", "not used"))

metric_labs <- c(
  "auc_vals"       = "AUC",
  "inflation_vals" = "Inflation Factor",
  "srmsd_vals"     = "SRMSDp"
)

source_labs <- c(
  "samafs" = "SAMAFS",
  "hchs"   = "HCHS/SOL"
)

library(ggh4x)
fig = ggplot(long_df, aes(x = analysis, y = value, fill = LOCO)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(x = "Analysis", y = "Values", fill = "LOCO") +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_grid2(
    rows = vars(source),
    cols = vars(metric),
    scales = "free_y",
    independent = "y",
    labeller = labeller(
      metric = as_labeller(metric_labs),
      source = as_labeller(source_labs)
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("not used" = "#00BFC4", "used" = "#F8766D")) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "/home/tt207/cryptic-relatedness/simtrait_LOCO_mask_metacorr.pdf",
  plot = fig,
  width = 12,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```
